text:
Fixed the LRU eviction bug.

Root cause: `LRUCache.__getitem__` returned values without updating the access order, so eviction followed insertion order.

Change: accesses now mark existing entries as recently used, including reads via `cache.get()`.

All 54 LRU/LFU tests pass.

final_text:
Fixed the LRU eviction bug.

Root cause: `LRUCache.__getitem__` returned values without updating the access order, so eviction followed insertion order.

Change: accesses now mark existing entries as recently used, including reads via `cache.get()`.

All 54 LRU/LFU tests pass.
